The season ran from 4 August 2023 and concluded on 25 May 2024. [[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] successfully defended the title with 6 games remaining, winning the title for the seventh consecutive year, starting from the [[2017–18 South African Premier Division|2017–18]] season.{{cite web|url=https://www.psl.co.za/news/article/5606844-sundowns-thump-chiefs-to-secure-seven|title=Official South African Premier Soccer League page|date=2 May 2024}} [[Kaizer Chiefs F.C.|Kaizer Chiefs]], who've won the title four times, finished tenth, their lowest ever finish in the [[Premier Soccer League|PSL]] era.{{Cite web |title=Chiefs lose at Spurs for worst-ever league finish |url=https://supersport.com/football/dstv-premiership/news/bb661d65-53c8-4cc1-829c-88a26f68e7a2/chiefs-lose-at-spurs-for-worst-ever-league-finish |access-date=2024-07-03 |website=SuperSport |language=en}} ==Teams== === Team changes === '''Promoted to 2023–24 South African Premiership''' •[[Polokwane City F.C.|Polokwane City]]{{Cite web |last=Rabothe |first=Tshepo |date=2023-05-14 |title=Polokwane City seal promotion back to DStv Premiership |url=https://farpost.co.za/2023/05/14/polokwane-city-seal-promotion-back-to-dstv-premiership/ |access-date=2023-06-15 |website=FARPost |language=en-ZA}} •[[Cape Town Spurs F.C.|Cape Town Spurs]]{{Cite web |last=Writer |first=S.
